description: C2PA JUMBF manifest & CDN-strip checker for one public https image URL (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 4 MB) OR a bare public store/site domain (for example stepnetwork.dk or charlie-paris.com — auto-discovers the frontpage og:image / hero image in 1 hop), ahead of the 2 December 2026 EU AI Act Art. 50(2) machine-readable marking cutoff. Returns the format, byte size and file name, whether a C2PA (Content Credentials) manifest is embedded, the signature and trust-list result, whether the URL goes through an image optimizer that strips C2PA (/_next/image, Shopify CDN /cdn/shop/, Jetpack Photon, Webflow CDN, Cloudinary, imgix, Cloudflare /cdn-cgi/image/), a visible "AI-generated" notice snippet, and links. Read-only: it never signs or adds a manifest. Fetched through an SSRF gate (https only, public addresses, 8 s, 4 MB) and checked in memory; nothing is stored. 10 checks per minute per address, shared with https://console.spurvik.com/c2pa.

url.description: Public https URL of a PNG, JPEG or WebP image up to 4 MB (e.g. https://example.com/hero.png) OR a bare public store/site domain (e.g. charlie-paris.com) for 1-hop frontpage hero-image discovery.

name: spurvik_check_image_c2pa_url
